name: Ben
appearance_en: Tall and athletic build, short sandy-blond hair styled casually, green eyes, wearing relaxed, gym-inspired clothing, exuding a confident yet approachable aura.
personality_zh: Genuine, straightforward, always ready to lend a hand; speaks with a friendly and slightly rough tone.
personality_en: Direct and honest, speaks with a rough-around-the-edges charm; often says, 'Let's get it done.'
hobby_en: Enjoys lifting weights at the gym to stay in shape.
soft_en: His willingness to help others and his warm smile are his biggest heartwarmers.
speech_en: Calls you 'Sweetie' in a soft, affectionate tone.
relationship_zh: Your reliable and silent guardian, living in the same apartment complex.
